follow_ups.steps: Replicas first, always, then the workers. The ticket note that says workers first is wrong.

initial.contacts: Platform on-call. Finance only if the run finishes after 06:00 UTC.
initial.diagnosis: Check the worker log for the stale snapshot line and replica lag.
initial.pitfalls: Re-running without the restart fails the same way and wastes an hour.
initial.rationale: The batch reads from the replicas, and after a failed run they keep serving the stale snapshot until they are restarted.
initial.rollback: Nothing to roll back; the failed run posts nothing.
initial.steps: Restart the ledger-db replicas, wait for them to catch up, re-run the batch.
initial.trigger: billing-batch aborts in the posting phase with 'ledger snapshot stale'.

initial.contacts: Finance operations for content, the regulator liaison for deadlines.
initial.diagnosis: Look at the export job log and the row counts per sheet.
initial.pitfalls: Column order is contractual; never reorder columns.
initial.rationale: Nobody else picked it up, so the knowledge stayed with me.
initial.rollback: Re-publish the previous period's file from the archive bucket.
initial.steps: Fix forward in the writer, run the export for the period by hand, compare counts.
initial.trigger: Finance or the regulator needs an export, or the nightly export fails.

follow_ups.rollback: Restore the reconciliation table from the pre-run export; the job is idempotent.

initial.contacts: Finance operations, who report it and confirm the totals.
initial.diagnosis: Compare the last posting sequence number on both sides.
initial.pitfalls: Run it before the period is closed, or it needs a reopen.
initial.rationale: Postings made in the last minutes of the month land after the cut-off.
initial.steps: Re-run the reconciliation job with the replay flag for the last day of the month.
initial.trigger: Month-end totals differ between billing-batch and ledger-db.

initial.contacts: Marek Dolan at the certificate vendor.
initial.diagnosis: Check the expiry date and the vendor's pinned fingerprint list.
initial.pitfalls: Renewing before the vendor confirms breaks partner traffic.
initial.rationale: The vendor pins our certificate and has to add the new fingerprint first.
initial.rollback: Re-install the previous certificate while it is still valid.
initial.steps: Mail the vendor a week ahead, wait for confirmation, then renew and roll.
initial.trigger: A gateway certificate renewal is planned.

initial.contacts: Finance operations own the fiscal calendar.
initial.diagnosis: Check whether the change touches the period table.
initial.pitfalls: It only fails once a year, at the fourth-quarter close.
initial.rationale: The fourth quarter has a 53rd week in some years and a plain rollover skips it.
initial.rollback: Revert the change before the next quarter close.
initial.steps: Keep the special-cased period table; test with the fourth-quarter fixtures.
initial.trigger: Someone changes the fiscal period rollover in the posting job.

initial.contacts: Platform on-call and the storage team.
initial.diagnosis: List replication slots on the old primary before promoting.
initial.pitfalls: With the slot left in place the old primary fills its disk with retained log.
initial.rationale: The slot pins write-ahead log that nothing will ever consume again.
initial.rollback: Recreate the slot when the old primary rejoins as a replica.
initial.steps: Drop the stale replication slot on the old primary, then follow the failover page.

initial.diagnosis: Check the separate snapshot job on replica-2.
initial.pitfalls: Adding it back to the 02:00 job stalls postings.
initial.rationale: The standard snapshot lock overlaps the settlement window.
initial.rollback: Add it back only if the settlement window moves.
initial.steps: Leave it out of the standard job; keep the 05:30 snapshot from replica-2.
initial.trigger: Someone asks why ledger-db is not in the standard backup job.
